mapper.select: SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName", p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode", p.PROJ_STAT_CD AS "statusCode", p.CTRT_BGN_DT AS "startDate", p.CTRT_END_DT AS "endDate", pp.PART_ID AS "salesPartId", pm.USER_ID AS "pmUserId", pm.USER_NM AS "pmName", p.BDGT_AMT AS "budgetAmount", (SELECT MAX(m.WRT_DT) FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO m WHERE m.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID) AS "latestMemoDate", (SELECT m.ACTL_PRGRS_RT FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO m WHERE m.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND m.ACTL_PRGRS_RT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.WRT_DT DESC, m.MEMO_SN DESC LIMIT 1) AS "actualProgress", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.LABOR_ALLOC_AMT+c.DRCT_EXPS_AMT) FROM TB_CO_MON_COST c WHERE c.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND c.COST_YM <= #{month}),0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.EXPS_AMT) FROM TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS e WHERE e.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND e.EXPS_YM <= #{month}),0) AS "costAmount" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT h.PART_ID FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART h WHERE h.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND h.APLY_BGN_YM <= #{month} ORDER BY h.APLY_BGN_YM DESC LIMIT 1 ) pp ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT u.USER_ID, u.USER_NM FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE sc WHERE sc.USER_ID=u.USER_ID AND sc.SCOPE_TYPE_CD='PROJ' AND sc.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE r WHERE r.USER_ID=u.USER_ID AND r.ROLE_ID='PM') ORDER BY u.USER_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) pm ON TRUE WHERE p.PROJ_STAT_CD NOT IN ('END','LOSE') AND p.CTRT_END_DT >= #{today} AND p.CTRT_TYPE_CD=#{filter.contractTypeCode} AND pp.PART_ID=#{filter.salesPartId} ORDER BY p.CTRT_BGN_DT DESC, p.PROJ_ID ASC
SELECT i.ISSUE_ID::text AS "issueId", i.IMPR_CD AS "importanceCode", i.ISSUE_STAT_CD AS "statusCode", i.DDLN_DT AS "dueDate" FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE i WHERE i.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} ORDER BY i.ISSUE_ID
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_BS_PART p WHERE p.PART_ID=#{partId})
